name: menu
title: Menu
description: A list of actions in a popover, placed against its button.
use: A few actions or links behind one button: the actions of a row, an account menu, the hidden levels of a breadcrumb. Items may be checkable, may open a submenu, and the menu may open at the pointer as a context menu. Without script it is a popover of buttons and links, so do not add role="menu"; add the roles only together with the behavior that provides arrow keys.

instead.when: It picks the value of a form field
The content is a form, a preview or anything but a list of actions
There are many commands and the reader finds one by typing
The choice must be made before the page is used again

keyboard.action: On the button with popovertarget: open or close the menu. On an item: run it, or open its submenu
Without the behavior: move through the items. With the behavior: close the menu and move on from its button
Close the menu, one level at a time when a submenu is open, and return focus to the button
With the behavior: move to the next or the previous item, skipping disabled ones and wrapping at the ends
With the behavior: move to the first or the last item
With the behavior: open the submenu of the focused item and move into it, or close the submenu and return to its item; the two change places in a right-to-left menu
With the behavior: move to the next item that starts with the typed letters
With contextMenu() from the behavior: open a menu-context at the focused element, as a right click and a long press do at the pointer

platform.feature: The popover attribute with popovertarget and popovertargetaction="hide"
platform.fallback: Supported in all current browsers: the menu opens, closes on an outside click or Escape and keeps a parent menu open under a submenu without script. A context menu has no declarative trigger: a script sets --menu-x and --menu-y and calls showPopover()
The menu still opens and closes; it appears centered in the viewport, where the browser places any popover, and a submenu does too
The context menu opens down and to the end of the pointer and does not turn back at the viewport edge
The menu appears and leaves at once, without the fade

classes.name: menu
classes.description: The floating list, on an element with the popover attribute; without the attribute it is never shown. It opens below its button, lined up with the start edge, at a distance of --anchored-gap (6px), and flips at the viewport edge

classes.name: menu-end
classes.description: Lines up with the button's end edge, for a button at the end of a row or a toolbar

classes.name: menu-sub
classes.description: A submenu: written right after the item that opens it, inside the parent menu, it opens beside that item

classes.name: menu-context
classes.description: A context menu: opens at --menu-x and --menu-y instead of against a button

classes.name: menu-item
classes.description: An action: a button, a link, or a label around a menu-input. An icon inside takes the item's size and stays quiet until the row is in use

classes.name: menu-item-danger
classes.description: A destructive action, in the danger ink

classes.name: menu-input
classes.description: The checkbox or radio inside a label item. It covers the row invisibly and keeps the state; the row shows a check at its end

classes.name: menu-shortcut
classes.description: A shortcut at the end of an item

classes.name: menu-label
classes.description: A quiet caption over a group of items

classes.name: menu-separator
classes.description: A hairline between groups, on an hr, running to the menu's edges

states.name: open
states.description: Set by the browser. A quiet button or a menu item right before an open menu stays lit

states.name: disabled
states.description: Or aria-disabled="true" on a link without href, or a disabled menu-input inside: disabled ink, no hover tone

states.name: checked
states.description: For an item driven by script with role="menuitemcheckbox" or role="menuitemradio": a check at the end of the row. aria-checked="false" keeps the room for it

states.name: checked
states.description: The native state of the checkbox or radio: its row shows the check

states.name: submenu
states.description: The item opens the menu-sub right after it: it gains a chevron at its end

properties.name: --menu-item-radius
properties.description: Row corner; the menu's corner is this plus the inset

properties.name: --menu-x
properties.description: Distance from the left edge of the viewport where a context menu opens, set by script from the event; 0px when not set

properties.name: --menu-y
properties.description: Distance from the top edge of the viewport where a context menu opens, set by script from the event; 0px when not set

properties.name: --anchored-gap
properties.description: Space between the surface and the control that opened it; 6px when not set

example: Settings
